notes:
- **Every frame after a pause on the network.** Wi-Fi often delivers several frames at once. On a screen faster than the stream (120 Hz for 60 frames a second) the Mac viewer now shows them all, in order, where 0.8.0 showed only the newest of them. Settings → Display has the switch.
- **A frame count you can trust:** the statistics panel counts the frames that reached the screen ("45 of 60 fps" when more arrived), not the frames that arrived.
